title: Scenario Reader
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Scenario_Reader.md
text: Read driving scenario into model, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Driving Scenario Designer file name} sets Scenario file name; {Source of driving scenario}, {MATLAB or model workspace variable name} sets the scenario variable name, {Coordinate system of actors output}, {Source of ego vehicle}, {Ego vehicle ActorID} sets the actor ID of ego vehicle, {Output ego vehicle pose} sets the output pose of ego vehicle, {Output ego vehicle state} sets the output state of ego vehicle, {Ego vehicle follows ground} sets the orient ego vehicle to follow road surface, {Sample time (s)} sets the sample time of simulation, {Lane boundaries to output}, {Distances from ego vehicle for computing boundaries (m)} sets the distances from ego vehicle at which to compute lane boundaries, {Location of boundaries on lane markings} sets the lane boundary location Center of lane, {Source of actors bus name} sets the source of name for actor poses bus, {Actors bus name} sets the name of actor poses bus valid, {Source of maximum number of actors}, {Maximum number of actors}, {Source of lane boundaries bus name} sets the source of name for lane boundaries bus, {Lane boundaries bus name} sets the name of lane boundaries bus valid, {Source of maximum number of lane boundaries}, {Maximum number of lane boundaries}, {Source of ego vehicle pose bus name} sets the source of name for ego vehicle pose bus, {Ego vehicle pose bus name} sets the name of ego vehicle pose bus valid bus, {Source of ego vehicle state bus name} sets the source of name for ego vehicle state bus, {Ego vehicle state bus name} sets the name of ego vehicle state bus valid bus, {Show coordinate labels} displays coordinate system of inputs and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
